reading_log_rules.selection_rule: The agent must review the user's full market-reading day and include only the top 10 items most worth preserving for the investor log.

selection_rules.selected_wow_rule: When selected_wow_id is a suggested WoW ID, pass-only fields must be absent or blank.
selection_rules.pass_rule: When selected_wow_id is none, pass-only fields are required.

agent_crawl_contract.selection_status: Derived by WKAP as selected when selected_wow_id is a suggested WoW ID, otherwise pass when selected_wow_id is none.

long_artifact_contract.raw_email_body: Must be stored completely before parsing.
long_artifact_contract.multiline_fields: Long multiline field values must be preserved in DB records and rendered HTML.
long_artifact_contract.transport_rule: Do not pass packet bodies through CLI arguments or shell command strings; use Gmail ingestion, files, stdin, or API payloads.

format_error_contract.sender_policy: Any sender may submit a Daily WoW Packet.
format_error_contract.save_first: Malformed packets must still be saved as RawEmail before parsing.
format_error_contract.published: Publish the ledger page and send the normal receipt.
format_error_contract.received_needs_format_fix: If deterministic repair/tolerance can parse the packet, publish it and send the normal receipt with a setup-format reminder. If WKAP cannot repair it safely, keep the raw email as needs_format_fix, do not publish, and send a format-fix receipt.
format_error_contract.rejected_spam_or_empty: Do not publish and do not send a receipt.
format_error_contract.publish_rule: Only publish packets that parse into reliable ledger fields.
format_error_contract.status: Set RawEmail.processing_status to needs_format_fix and store the parser message in error_message.
format_error_contract.receipt: Send or preview a format-fix receipt describing the missing or invalid field.
